assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons are participant models, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All siting and area claims remain provisional and must be recomputed from official geometry.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, heritage, green/blue lines, road/rail controls, tenure and municipal capacity were not provided.
assumptions.impact: No statutory, engineering, ownership or capacity conclusion is made.

assumptions.statement: Current accessibility, population, visitor demand, staffing, budget, sample frame and operating workload are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Protocol bands are shadow-test rules only and require later calibration.

assumptions.statement: Only public, consented or anonymized aggregate inputs may enter a prototype; no individual tracking is required.
assumptions.impact: Identifying or unconsented output stops the scenario and triggers deletion/rollback.

assumptions.statement: Consequential, accessibility, heritage, safety and publication decisions require a named human reviewer.
assumptions.impact: AI cannot make final decisions; unattended output is not published.

assumptions.statement: Six global ecosystem cases are mechanism references pending source, fact and reuse verification.
assumptions.impact: They cannot support local performance, funding or partnership claims.

assumptions.statement: Trademark clearance, historical-material reuse and external publication authorization are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: PAR·JZ remains a concept name; unverified assets are not represented as licensed.

assumptions.statement: The operator, independent review panel and professional teams are proposed roles, not appointed entities.
assumptions.impact: RACI and phase gates are a handoff framework pending responsible-party confirmation.
